# indexes folder

Holds the full-text search indexes generated by the application.

> This folder is entirely managed by the app — **do not edit it manually**.
> Indexes are generated from the "Indexes" page of the interface.

## Automatically generated structure

Each index is a subfolder named `idx_<timestamp>_<slug>` (e.g.
`idx_20260115103000_hospital-index`). An index can combine several **sources**, each source
being one OCR model of one collection.

```
indexes/
└── idx_20260115103000_hospital-index/
    ├── metadata.json               → status, sources, stats, dates
    └── index.json                  → dictionary of word → list of occurrences (with coordinates)
```

## metadata.json format

```json
{
  "id": "idx_20260115103000_hospital-index",
  "name": "Hospital index",
  "sources": [
    {
      "key": "s0",
      "collection_id": "my-collection",
      "collection_folder": "my-collection",
      "collection_titre": "Hospital registers",
      "model_name": "my-model"
    }
  ],
  "status": "ready",
  "created_at": "2026-01-15T10:30:00",
  "stats": {
    "total_unique_words": 12500,
    "total_word_occurrences": 85000,
    "registres_count": 30,
    "year_min": 1830,
    "year_max": 1975
  }
}
```

Indexes can be regenerated at any time from the interface without data loss.
